newsitem.title: USA: Bangor Hydro seeks natgas pipeline voice.
newsitem.headline: Bangor Hydro seeks natgas pipeline voice.

text.p: Bangor Hydro-Electric Co said it filed with the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission Monday seeking intervenor status in the Maritimes & Northeast Pipeline LLC case.

Maritimes & Northeast is the first phase of a pipeline which plans to ship natural gas from Sable Isalnd off Canada's east coast to the U.S. it is co-owned by PanEnergy Corp, Westcoast Energy Inc, Eastern Enterprises and Mobil Corp.
Bangor Hydro noted Maritime proposes secondary pipelines to serve individual industrial customers in Maine.

In its filing, the electric utility asked that the permits allowing these laterals include sufficient conditions to assure that the provision of natural gas service to these industrial customers will not result in stranded costs for Bangor Hydro.
Spokesman Bill Cohen noted that FERC has set limits, in various rulings over the years, on switching between electric suppliers and between natural gas suppliers.
The company is seeking a similar ruling on an electric power user's switch to natural gas.
